enchantments.tooltip: +1 Enhancement Bonus: +1 enhancement bonus to Armor Class.
Mithral: Mithral armor is one type lighter then normal. Arcane Spell Failure decreased by 10%. Maximum dexterity bonus increased by 2. Armor check penalty reduced by 3.
Melee Alacrity 10%: Gain 10% Enhancement bonus to Melee attack speed. Does not stack with the Haste spell.
Striding +15%: This item makes you more fleet of foot, giving you a 15% Enhancement bonus your movement speed.
